commit.message: fix(runtime): bind heartbeat and health authority

interface_mismatches: RuntimeStateStore persists claims and runs across process boots, while heartbeat authority exists only in the current process and cannot be inferred from an in-flight database status.

DHARMA_READ_ONLY_BOOT skips initialization writes but the production orchestrate-live loop still mutates TaskBoard and RuntimeStateStore; mandatory prior-incarnation reconciliation must therefore precede that shortcut.
TaskBoard requeue and RuntimeState terminalization are separate projections; recovery receipts must preserve execution identity and remain distinct from process liveness.
HealthStatus is a typed operational verdict, but the CLI currently erases it into exit code zero, allowing downstream automation to promote degraded or critical state into success.
honest_blockers: The immutable live release is repaired in an isolated branch because the canonical feature checkout contains unrelated user changes and is not a safe edit surface.
A terminal recovery receipt proves a bounded local state transition, not successful external work, executor liveness, or semantic task completion.
Legacy rows without a complete ExecutionIdentity cannot receive an authority-bearing terminal receipt; reconciliation must remain fail-closed and report that evidence gap.
Repository tests do not prove launchd restart health, remote SSH reachability, Slack delivery, or one end-to-end model task; those are separately verified operational steps.
